name: NoBrokerHood Accounting AI knowledge base
description: Versioned accounting knowledge used by the local Accounting AI: document signatures, field vocabulary, GST/TDS reference data, society accounting concepts, validation rule catalog and company policies. Company-specific policies that are not defined in project requirements are marked POLICY_REQUIRED instead of being assumed.

changelog.change: Initial knowledge base for local (no-Gemini) Accounting AI.
